text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking around the academy, I heard a familiar voice...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —And with that, peace was restored to the world.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
It still feels like they're just reading off a script.
choice_data_list: What are you two up to?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Actually, we've decided to put on a play for some invited children soon.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I am currently undergoing intensive training in an "RPG-style heroic saga" YEEES!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I want to do a thorough job with what was asked of me, but...
it ended up turning out pretty run-of-the-mill.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! In that case, El can finish things off
with a Flying Body Press—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, Aile~?
What if the little kids try to copy you? That would be dangerous, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ow ow ow ow!
Okay, okay! I get it alreadyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, the two of them continued practicing for a long time...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Putting together an enjoyable play
is quite challenging, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
How about making the lines easier to understand?
Let's start from a script read-through once more and—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
O-One more time!?
Whoaaa... Grass is in serious mode~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Childhood experiences are very important, after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: In the past, I too was deeply moved by and longed for Japanese culture, where heart and soul are poured into the very tips of one's fingers and brushstrokes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to experience that same deep emotion.
I just really hope... we can put on a play like that.
choice_data_list: Let's make it a truly moving play, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nu-nuun! El will too! I'll deliver that same thrill I felt watching pro-wrestling as a kid!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Well then, let's do a read-through right away.
Trainer, please join in as the antagonist—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after practicing the play day after day...
the day of the performance finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Guh... As expected of the Demon King...
Enemy or not, that was... a fine blow, yes..."
choice_data_list: Mwahaha! Time for the finishing blow!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~~!! Do your best!
Don't lose to the Demon King!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes... we cannot afford to lose.
For the sake of everyone who cheers us on.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Take all of my feelings!
"Angel Fall"!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Haaah!! Condor Roaring Wave--!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaaa~~h!!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you were amazing! Even when I'm
scared, I'll be brave and do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! I thought, "I'm not gonna lose!"
I wanna see the play again!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Fufufu, thank you.
I take it you enjoyed the play?
choice_data_list: That's the result of all your hard work.
That's the fruit of all your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Fufufu, thank you.
I take it you enjoyed the play?
choice_data_list: That's the result of all your hard work.
That's the fruit of all your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Thank you as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Not only did you offer your advice, but you even played the villain, which led to this success.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, let's try doing what they just did!

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! ...Take this feeling!
Angel Faaaall!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, why don't we sit back and enjoy ourselves as guests next time?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Think of it as, like, a quest reward in a game♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we enjoyed the children's
heartwarming play.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A concert would make sense, but...
an encore for a play...?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see, I wanna seee!
Encore, encore!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu,
with you begging so earnestly, how could I say no?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go, Trainer?
Let's give everything we've worked so hard for up until today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And answering the encore,
the event drew to a close amid tremendous applause.
